minetorio.ponder.head_3x3.text_1: The tip is a column of Drill Head blocks: 1x1, two blocks tall.
minetorio.ponder.head_3x3.text_2: Above it goes a cross of 5 blocks, two layers high.
minetorio.ponder.head_3x3.text_3: The top layer is a solid 3x3 square.
minetorio.ponder.head_3x3.text_4: Build the head exactly in this shape with the tip down, and glue all its blocks together with Super Glue.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_1: The tip is a column of Drill Head blocks: 1x1, two blocks tall.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_2: Above it goes a cross of 5 blocks, two layers high.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_4: Two layers of a 13-block diamond follow.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_5: The top layer is a 5x5 square with its corners cut off: 21 blocks.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_6: Build the head exactly in this shape with the tip down, and glue all its blocks together with Super Glue.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_1: Quarry drills work on ore patches. Build the drill right above the ore.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_2: A Mechanical Piston facing down lowers the drill. Every Piston Extension Pole behind it adds one block of reach.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_3: Under the piston goes a platform of Drill Platform blocks, with a Mechanical Bearing facing down in its centre.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_4: The Drill Head hangs under the bearing. Glue all its blocks together so the bearing carries them as one piece.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_5: Power the bearing and the piston. The head spins and sinks until it stops just above the ore. It never breaks any blocks.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_6: The drive needs 1024 SU at 32 RPM. At 32 RPM it yields 1 ore block and 1 raw ore every 5 minutes; every extra 32 RPM multiplies that.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_7: Place the drive with right-click to make the red-dot output face you, or while sneaking to face away. Ore is pushed into an adjacent chest or belt.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_1: Quarry drills work on ore patches. Build the drill right above the ore.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_2: A Mechanical Piston facing down lowers the drill. Every Piston Extension Pole behind it adds one block of reach.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_3: Under the piston goes a platform of Drill Platform blocks, with a Mechanical Bearing facing down in its centre.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_4: The Drill Head hangs under the bearing. Glue all its blocks together so the bearing carries them as one piece.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_5: Power the bearing and the piston. The head spins and sinks until it stops just above the ore. It never breaks any blocks.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_6: The drive needs 1536 SU at 32 RPM. At 32 RPM it yields 2 ore blocks and 3 raw ore every 5 minutes; every extra 32 RPM multiplies that.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_7: Place the drive with right-click to make the red-dot output face you, or while sneaking to face away. Ore is pushed into an adjacent chest or belt.
